reviews.comment:
Parada obligatoria para cargar combustible, pero las condiciones de esta estación de servicio son realmente lamentables. El predio está lleno de barro, con pozos enormes que dificultan tanto el ingreso como la circulación, especialmente en días de lluvia.

Resulta sorprendente el estado de abandono de un lugar que recibe tantos vehículos a diario. Una estación de servicio debería ofrecer, además de combustible, un entorno seguro, limpio y bien mantenido. Ojalá sus responsables inviertan en mejorar la infraestructura, porque en las condiciones actuales deja una muy mala impresión. Sobre todo por ser transitada por turistas. 😥😥😥

(Translated by Google)
A mandatory stop for fuel, but the conditions at this gas station are truly deplorable. The grounds are muddy, with enormous potholes that make both entry and driving difficult, especially on rainy days.

The state of neglect of a place that receives so many vehicles daily is astonishing. A gas station should offer, in addition to fuel, a safe, clean, and well-maintained environment. Hopefully, those responsible will invest in improving the infrastructure, because in its current state it leaves a very bad impression, especially given that it's frequented by tourists. 😥😥😥

reviews.comment:
(Translated by Google) We were on a motorcycle, we stopped at a gas station at 4 PM because of the bad weather. We asked the staff if we could camp there and they said yes. At 10 PM, when the convenience store closed, another guy from the gas station came and said we couldn't stay, that we had to take down the tent and leave. TEN AT NIGHT, 3 DEGREES CELSIUS, in a place where there's NOTHING within a 100km radius. We went through a terrible ordeal and, worse, the EXACT SAME THING happened to a friend. At the same gas station, the same guy, at 10 PM, he made him pack up his things and ride 200km at night in the rain. Unbelievable.

(Original)
Estávamos de moto, paramos às 16h no posto por conta do mau tempo. Pedimos para o pessoal do posto para acampar ali e eles disseram que sim. Às 22h, quando fechou a conveniência, veio um outro cara do posto dizendo que não poderíamos ficar, que tínhamos que desarmar a barraca e ir embora. DEZ DA NOITE, 3 GRAUS, em um lugar onde não tem NADA num raio de 100km. Passamos o maior sufoco e, o pior, aconteceu EXATAMENTE A MESMA COISA com um amigo. No mesmo posto, o mesmo cara, 22h da noite fez ele desmontar as coisas e rodar 200km à noite e na chuva. Inacreditável.
